lines.en: label church10:
scene black
scene clearnightsky
On nights like tonight, I find myself wandering somewhere between complacency and cowardice.
lines.zh: 像今晚这样的夜里，我发现自己在自满与怯懦之间的某处游荡。

lines.en: Trying to skirt the line between what it means to fall into form and what it means to break free.
lines.zh: 试图在“落入规矩”与“挣脱束缚”之间踩着那条线走。

lines.en: But free from what?
lines.zh: 可是，从什么里挣脱？

lines.en: The only thing preventing me from floating away is a small anchor surgically inserted into every girl I know.
lines.zh: 唯一阻止我飘走的，是一枚被手术植入我认识的每一个女孩体内的小小锚。

lines.en: An anchor that grows as a direct result of how much “warmth” I give them, as someone like Yasu would put it.
lines.zh: 按 Yasu 那种人的说法，那枚锚会随着我给予她们多少“温暖”而长大。

lines.en: With each orgasm comes an increased connection that will evolve into increased emotional damage depending on who finds out what and when.
lines.zh: 每一次高潮都带来更深的牵连，而那份牵连，会演变成更重的情感伤害——取决于谁在什么时候发现了什么。

lines.en: And yet I stray...
lines.zh: 而我依然在偏离……

lines.en: Further and further into the darkness that some see as light, with my hands clasped together.
lines.zh: 越走越深，走进那片有人视作光明的黑暗，双手十指紧扣。

lines.en: My fingers go to war with one another, using the sharp edges of nails to claw away at others who look just like them on the opposing side.
lines.zh: 我的手指互相开战，用指甲的锋利边缘去抓挠对岸那些长得跟它们一模一样的手指。

lines.en: A whole other world, though not at all dissimilar to the one they’ve spent 31 years familiarizing themselves with.
lines.zh: 一个完整的异世界，尽管与他们花了 31 年去熟悉的世界并无二致。

lines.en: That’s the overly intellectual, artistic way of saying that I begin to pick at my nails.
lines.zh: 这是那种过于文艺、过于矫饰的说法，意思就是：我开始抠指甲了。

lines.en: I lose track of how hard I must be doing it and manage to cut myself.
lines.zh: 我失了分寸，抠得太狠，居然把自己抠出了血。

lines.en: Blood flows out.
lines.zh: 血流了出来。

lines.en: Not a lot of blood. But enough to remind me of the color of my [niece]’s hair.
lines.zh: 血不多。但足够让我想起我[niece]头发的颜色。

lines.en: Hers is a lighter shade of red.
lines.zh: 她的红要浅一些。

lines.en: Just like [[redacted].
lines.zh: 就像 [[redacted]。

lines.en: scene yasublind1
I make my way into New Hope Cathedral and attempt to shake off any uneasiness that may have snuck into my mind on the journey over.
lines.zh: 我走进 New Hope Cathedral，试图甩掉这一路上悄悄钻进脑子里的不安。

lines.en: The walk isn’t as bad as the one I so commonly take to the second half of town.
lines.zh: 这段路并不比我常去的那条通往城后半区的路糟糕。

lines.en: In fact, coming here allows me to pass through several locations that make the cold seem not that cold at all.
lines.zh: 事实上，来这儿让我得以穿过好几个地方，让寒冷显得一点也不冷了。

lines.en: Some nights, when the temperature is low enough, I like to watch the exhaust fumes from the pipes of closing restaurants clash with the winter wind and explode into gray vapor.
lines.zh: 有些夜里，气温足够低的时候，我喜欢看打烊餐馆管道排出的废气撞上冬风，炸成灰色的水汽。

lines.en: I like to walk through it, half expecting to feel something, but remembering as I pass through that I, too, am vaporous.
lines.zh: 我喜欢走进那团水汽里，半抱着能感觉到些什么的期待，却在穿过去的瞬间想起，我自己也是一团水汽。

lines.en: And that the reason I can not feel is not that there are no feelings to be felt, but that I have already felt them all.
lines.zh: 而我之所以什么都感觉不到，并不是因为没有感觉可去感受，而是因为我早已把它们全都感受过了。

lines.en: There is nothing left for me here.
lines.zh: 这里已经没有任何东西属于我了。

lines.en: : Blessed be those who give up their eyes.
lines.zh: : 舍弃双眼的人有福了。

lines.en: : Who trade in their sight for the sake of a prize.
lines.zh: : 为了奖赏而交出视力的人有福了。

lines.en: : Blessed be those who reach out their hands.
lines.zh: : 伸出双手的人有福了。

lines.en: : Who sit in the church, so outside He can stand.
lines.zh: : 坐在教堂里的人有福了，好让祂能站在外面。

lines.en: : Good morning, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 早上好，Sensei。

lines.en: : You could tell I was here?
lines.zh: : 你能看出来我来了？

lines.en: scene churchglow1
scene yasublind2
: Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : The door isn’t exactly quiet.
lines.zh: : 那扇门可一点都不安静。

lines.en: : And it’s not like anyone else has ever visited me here before.
lines.zh: : 再说，反正也从没有别人来这儿看过我。

lines.en: : Right.
lines.zh: : 也是。

lines.en: : So...are you having fun?
lines.zh: : 那么……你玩得开心吗？

lines.en: : Not at all.
lines.zh: : 一点也不。

lines.en: : I am barred from having fun tonight, you see.
lines.zh: : 你看，今晚我被禁止享乐。

lines.en: : And so I shall sit here, thinking nothing. Seeing nothing. Being nothing.
lines.zh: : 所以我要坐在这儿，什么都不想。什么都不看。什么都不做。

lines.en: : All so He can feel what it means to be alive once more, if even for a fraction of a second.
lines.zh: : 只为让祂能再一次体会活着是什么感觉，哪怕只有一秒钟的几分之一。

lines.en: : Well I guess I better go then. I’m a really exciting guy and don’t want you to accidentally enjoy yourself or anything.
lines.zh: : 那我大概还是走吧。我这个人可太有意思了，可不想让你一不小心享受起来什么的。

lines.en: : There’s no need to go anywhere, Sensei. I can talk.
lines.zh: : 您不必走，Sensei。我能说话。

lines.en: : In fact, I’d love for you to stay and chat.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我很想让你留下来聊聊。

lines.en: : Though, I implore you not to look at me or attempt to take advantage of me.
lines.zh: : 不过，我恳求你别看我，也别想趁机占我便宜。

lines.en: : I’m rather defenseless tonight.
lines.zh: : 今晚我相当没有防备。

lines.en: : You’re barely over five feet tall and I’m pretty sure I could snap you in half with one arm.
lines.zh: : 你也就刚过五英尺，我敢说我一只胳膊就能把你折成两半。

lines.en: : You’re rather defenseless every night.
lines.zh: : 你每天晚上都相当没有防备。

lines.en: : Hehehe~
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~

lines.en: : Yes. I suppose you’re right about that.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我想你说得对。

lines.en: : But that’s not what I am talking about.
lines.zh: : 不过我说的不是这个。

lines.en: : Please, take a seat.
lines.zh: : 请坐吧。

lines.en: scene black
scene yasublind3
: Feel free to sit down whenever you like, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 您想什么时候坐下都行，Sensei。

lines.en: : I’m right next to you.
lines.zh: : 我就在你旁边。

lines.en: : Oh. I’m very sorry. You were much quieter than I anticipated.
lines.zh: : 哦。非常抱歉。你比我想象中要安静得多。

lines.en: : Yasu.
lines.zh: : Yasu。

lines.en: : Yes?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : I’m really going to need an explanation for this.
lines.zh: : 我真的很需要你给我解释一下这是怎么回事。

lines.en: : You wish to learn more about he who sleeps?
lines.zh: : 你想了解更多关于那位沉睡之主的事吗？

lines.en: : I wish to learn more about Yasu who blindfolds herself with tape in the middle of a church at night.
lines.zh: : 我想了解更多关于 Yasu 大半夜在教堂里用胶带蒙住自己眼睛的事。

lines.en: : A much less interesting story, though one I’d be happy to tell.
lines.zh: : 那可就无趣多了，不过我也很乐意讲。

lines.en: : Please keep it as minimally propagandic as possible.
lines.zh: : 请尽量少带一点宣传色彩。

lines.en: : Hehehe~
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : I doubt this aspect would convert you to a believer either way.
lines.zh: : 反正这部分大概也不管能不能把你发展成信徒。

lines.en: : It is simply how we show our thanks.
lines.zh: : 它不过是我们表达感谢的方式。

lines.en: : How {i}you{/i} show your thanks.
lines.zh: : 是“{i}你{/i}”表达感谢的方式。

lines.en: : For now.
lines.zh: : 暂时是。

lines.en: : More will come, if they do not already exist.
lines.zh: : 会有更多人来的，如果他们还未曾存在的话。

lines.en: : They could always be hiding as well.
lines.zh: : 他们也可能只是躲起来了。

lines.en: : I would not blame them if they were.
lines.zh: : 要是那样，我也不会怪他们。

lines.en: : Have you ever wanted something you couldn’t have?
lines.zh: : 你有没有渴望过某样你得不来的东西？

lines.en: scene attempting
: Actually, let me tell you a little anecdote that will explain things better than a simple question would.
lines.zh: : 其实，我给你讲个小故事吧，它比一个简单的问题更能说明白。

lines.en: : A baby is born. There is no sense in giving it a name.
lines.zh: : 一个婴儿出生了。给它取名字没有意义。

lines.en: : It is a normal baby. All of the parts are there.
lines.zh: : 那是个普通的婴儿。零件全都齐全。

lines.en: : The ears, the mouth, the nose, the limbs, the eyes. Everything.
lines.zh: : 耳朵、嘴巴、鼻子、四肢、眼睛。什么都有。

lines.en: : But some of the parts don’t work.
lines.zh: : 只是有些零件不好使。

lines.en: : If life worked the way a conveyor belt in a shop that mass produces dolls works, and this baby was to be a biomechanical retail product, those parts could be replaced.
lines.zh: : 如果生命像量产人偶的店里那条传送带一样运作，而这个婴儿是一件生物机械的零售商品，那些零件就可以被换掉。

lines.en: : If the arms bent the wrong way, it would receive new arms.
lines.zh: : 要是胳膊弯的方向不对，它就能换一对新胳膊。

lines.en: : If the ears heard nothing but a high pitched noise, reminiscent of screeching tires or the whisper of melting plastic, those too could be replaced.
lines.zh: : 要是耳朵里只听得见尖锐的高音，像轮胎的刮擦声或塑料融化的低语，那对耳朵也能换掉。

lines.en: : And while that much reigns true for humans to some extent, one thing that is almost always guaranteed is that those born blind will never see.
lines.zh: : 虽说这些在某种程度上对人类也成立，但几乎有一条是铁律：先天失明的人，永远看不见。

lines.en: : They can not comprehend the colors of the world.
lines.zh: : 他们无法理解世间的颜色。

lines.en: : They can not gawk at the beauty of the sakura season, smiling as petals fall off of the trees and into their outstretched hands.
lines.zh: : 他们无法为樱花季的美而惊叹，无法笑着看花瓣从枝头飘落，落进他们摊开的手心。

lines.en: : The baby in this anecdote refuses to accept that.
lines.zh: : 这个故事里的婴儿，拒绝接受这一点。

lines.en: : He grows older.
lines.zh: : 他长大了。

lines.en: : He lives for thousands and millions and billions and trillions of years and sees absolutely nothing.
lines.zh: : 他活了成千上万年、上百万年、上亿年、上兆年，却什么都没看见。

lines.en: : He lives for so long that his notoriety grows and he becomes known around the world as the man who sees nothing.
lines.zh: : 他活得太久，名声也越来越大，全世界都知道有这样一个什么都看不见的人。

lines.en: : Some people, whether it be through inspiration or pity, wind up surrendering their eyes to him in an effort to restore his vision.
lines.zh: : 有些人，或是出于敬佩，或是出于怜悯，最终把自己的眼睛献给他，想让他重见光明。

lines.en: : His original eyes are removed in favor of the new ones, but none of them work.
lines.zh: : 他原本的眼睛被摘下，换上新的，可没有一双管用。

lines.en: : The spare eyes are kept in a jar in his home, but the jar gains vision itself and must be put out of its misery.
lines.zh: : 备用的眼睛被泡在他家里的一只罐子里，可那只罐子自己长出了视力，只好被处理掉，免得继续受苦。

lines.en: : He begins to sew the eyes to his body, thinking that maybe his brain would realize what he was attempting to do.
lines.zh: : 他开始把那些眼睛缝到自己身上，心想也许他的大脑能明白他想要做什么。

lines.en: : It realized nothing.
lines.zh: : 大脑什么也没明白。

lines.en: : Eventually, the man was covered in eyes. And yet, he was just as blind as he was when he was born.
lines.zh: : 最终，这个男人浑身被眼睛覆盖。可他依然和出生时一样瞎。

lines.en: : He accepts that he will never see and hides himself away in the depths of a sewer.
lines.zh: : 他接受了自己永远看不见的事实，把自己藏进下水道深处。

lines.en: : And he sleeps for years.
lines.zh: : 然后他睡了很多年。

lines.en: : He becomes depressed and gives up on eating.
lines.zh: : 他变得抑郁，不再进食。

lines.en: : He dies.
lines.zh: : 他死了。

lines.en: : But he lives for so long before that, covered in eyes to the point of being unable to move...that his other senses begin to dissipate.
lines.zh: : 可在那之前，他活了那么久，浑身缝满眼睛，久到动弹不得……以至于他其他的感觉也开始消散。

lines.en: : The near deafening silence of a sewer in an abandoned town, where the only sound to be heard is the occasional drip of rain-
lines.zh: : 废弃小镇下水道里那近乎震耳的寂静，唯一能听见的声音是偶尔滴落的雨水——

lines.en: : He tunes it out.
lines.zh: : 他把那声音屏蔽了。

lines.en: : The taste of the retinal fluid sliding across his tongue and down the back of his throat-
lines.zh: : 视网膜液滑过舌尖、淌下喉咙的味道——

lines.en: : He tunes it out.
lines.zh: : 他把它屏蔽了。

lines.en: : All senses are numbed to the point where, when he passes onto the second plane, he does not even realize he has passed.
lines.zh: : 所有感官都麻木到了这种程度：当他去往第二重境界时，他甚至没意识到自己已经去了。

lines.en: : But that’s when something wonderful happens.
lines.zh: : 但就在那时，奇妙的事情发生了。

lines.en: scene yasublind4
: He sees for the first time.
lines.zh: : 他第一次看见了。

lines.en: : Not through his own eyes or the eyes that had been gifted and then sewn onto him, as those had all faded into nothingness with his descension.
lines.zh: : 不是通过他自己的眼睛，也不是通过那些被赠予又缝到他身上的眼睛——那些眼睛都随着他的坠落化作了虚无。

lines.en: : But through the memories of the eyes of others, swimming through the air around him.
lines.zh: : 而是通过别人眼睛里的记忆，那些记忆在他周围的空气中游动。

lines.en: : Each vision flowed into him. And in return, he shared himself with the visions.
lines.zh: : 一幕幕景象流入他体内。作为回报，他也把自己分享给了那些景象。

lines.en: : It was then that he realized he was born as he was for a reason.
lines.zh: : 就在那时，他意识到，自己生来如此是有原因的。

lines.en: : That being born without vision was not a setback, but the mark of something beautiful.
lines.zh: : 生来没有视力不是缺陷，而是某种美好事物的印记。

lines.en: : Every year of agony was counteracted with a lifetime worth of wonderful sights.
lines.zh: : 每一年的痛苦，都被整整一生的美妙景象抵消了。

lines.en: : The birth of all children. Fireworks in the summer. The long awaited sakura season.
lines.zh: : 所有孩子的诞生。夏日的烟火。盼望已久的樱花季。

lines.en: : He could smell the petals and hear the sizzle of grilled meat at food stands lining unfamiliar courtyards.
lines.zh: : 他能闻到花瓣的气味，能听见陌生庭院里小吃摊上烤肉的滋滋声。

lines.en: : And yet it all felt so familiar.
lines.zh: : 可这一切却又熟悉得不可思议。

lines.en: scene yasublind5
: And then it stopped.
lines.zh: : 然后，它停止了。

lines.en: : He had gotten a taste, but the taste vanished as quickly as it had appeared.
lines.zh: : 他尝到了一点甜头，可那甜头消失得和出现时一样快。

lines.en: : The whispers in the wind saw how quickly the man of many eyes was changing. Growing.
lines.zh: : 风中的低语看见这个长着许多眼睛的人变化得有多快。成长得有多快。

lines.en: : And it frightened them.
lines.zh: : 它们害怕了。

lines.en: : They started giving their memories to other people instead.
lines.zh: : 它们开始把自己的记忆交给别人。

lines.en: : People who were not lusting after the chance to start anew, but a chance to relive their lives despite hating so much of them.
lines.zh: : 交给那些并不渴望重新开始、而是渴望重活一遍人生的人——尽管他们恨透了其中的大部分。

lines.en: : This made the blind man sad.
lines.zh: : 这让那个盲人心痛。

lines.en: : But still, he held out hope.
lines.zh: : 可他依然抱着希望。

lines.en: : He knew that one day, word of his story would reach someone.
lines.zh: : 他知道，总有一天，他的故事会传到某个人耳朵里。

lines.en: : Someone who would bridge the gap and connect him to the world.
lines.zh: : 某个人会架起那座桥，把他和世界连起来。

lines.en: : But how?
lines.zh: : 可是，怎么做呢？

lines.en: : The answer to that question is why I am blind tonight.
lines.zh: : 这个问题的答案，就是我今晚失明的原因。

lines.en: : I have foregone my own vision so that he may see in my place.
lines.zh: : 我舍弃了自己的视力，好让他借我的眼睛去看。

lines.en: : And I would forego it for the rest of eternity if it meant that he who suffers most would not have to suffer any longer.
lines.zh: : 哪怕要我永远舍弃下去，只要那个受苦最深的人不必再受苦，我也愿意。

lines.en: : But it does not work that way.
lines.zh: : 可惜事情并不是这样运作的。

lines.en: : I can only sacrifice my sight on nights like tonight.
lines.zh: : 我只能在像今晚这样的夜里献出视力。

lines.en: : Nights where we haphazardly wander between complacency and cowardice, skirting the line between our own comfort and the things we fear the most.
lines.zh: : 在这样的夜里，我们在自满与怯懦之间胡乱游荡，在自身的安逸与最惧怕的事物之间踩线而行。

lines.en: : Do you understand now, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你现在明白了吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: scene yasublind6
: Huh? What?
lines.zh: : 嗯？什么？

lines.en: : Do you understand the reason for the tape over my eyes?
lines.zh: : 你明白我眼睛上贴胶带的原因了吗？

lines.en: : I’m sure the anecdote sounded rather silly if you’re unfamiliar with the story I based it off of, but I’m happy with how accurate it was.
lines.zh: : 我相信，如果你不熟悉我这个故事所依据的原典，听上去大概挺傻的，不过我对它的还原度很满意。

lines.en: scene yasublind7
: Yeah...sure.
lines.zh: : 嗯……当然。

lines.en: Again, I managed to zone out while talking to Yasu. Though, this time, I’m pretty sure it was entirely out of boredom.
lines.zh: 我又一次在跟 Yasu 说话时走了神。不过这次，我敢说完全是因为无聊。

lines.en: I’m not really one for long winded stories, let alone ones that go on to explain whatever weird religious purpose there is for blindfolding herself.
lines.zh: 我本来就不喜欢长篇大论的故事，更别说还是用来解释她蒙住自己眼睛的某种奇怪宗教理由。

lines.en: It’s probably just safe to assume it has something to do with that prayer she’s always whispering about giving up eyes.
lines.zh: 大概可以稳妥地假设，这跟她老是念叨的那句“舍弃双眼”的祷文有关。

lines.en: : Wonderful.
lines.zh: : 太好了。

lines.en: : If I were allowed to have fun tonight, I would jump for joy.
lines.zh: : 要是今晚允许我享乐，我一定会高兴得跳起来。

lines.en: : But unfortunately, I have to be available for God until he’s able to function on his own again.
lines.zh: : 可惜，在他能重新独立运作之前，我必须随时待命。

lines.en: : What do you mean, “function on his own?”
lines.zh: : “独立运作”是什么意思？

lines.en: : He doesn’t handle the cold very well. It makes his legs lock up and his teeth chatter.
lines.zh: : 他不太抗冻。天一冷，他的腿就会僵住，牙齿也会打颤。

lines.en: : So I allow him to see through me when he wants to.
lines.zh: : 所以他想看的时候，我就让他借我的眼睛去看。

lines.en: : I do wish he’d call on me more often, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我真希望他能多召唤我几次。

lines.en: : But I suppose that without many happy memories, there is only so much he can gain from peering into my looking glass.
lines.zh: : 但我想，没有多少快乐的记忆，他从我的窥镜里能看到的也就有限了。

lines.en: : I feel like I should ask you to embellish on that “lack of happy memories” thing. That sounds important.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我该请你细说一下“缺少快乐记忆”这件事。听起来很重要。

lines.en: : What is important right now is devoting myself entirely to Him.
lines.zh: : 现在最重要的是把我整个献给祂。

lines.en: : This is His night. And all stories regarding Yasu Yasui must be shelved until that subsides.
lines.zh: : 今晚属于祂。所有关于 Yasu Yasui 的故事都得先搁置，等这一切过去再说。

lines.en: : Perhaps ask me again when the heat returns and I am free to switch colors.
lines.zh: : 也许等热气回来、我能自由换色的时候，你再问一次吧。

lines.en: : But, until then-
lines.zh: : 不过，在那之前——

lines.en: : May the path be a path or whatever. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 愿你的路是条路什么的。行吧。

lines.en: : May the path you walk be free of callousness.
lines.zh: : 愿你行走的路上没有冷酷。

lines.en: : Thank you for visiting tonight.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你今晚来看我。

lines.en: : I’m sorry I could not be as “entertaining” as I normally am.
lines.zh: : 抱歉我没能像平时那样“有趣”。

lines.en: : But I need to focus or He will get angry.
lines.zh: : 可我必须专注，否则祂会生气。

lines.en: : And things get very loud when He is angry.
lines.zh: : 而祂生气的时候，动静会非常大。

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: : Well, uhh...
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……

lines.en: : Goodnight then.
lines.zh: : 那晚安吧。

lines.en: : Goodnight.
lines.zh: : 晚安。

lines.en: : Safe travels.
lines.zh: : 一路平安。

lines.en: : Remember to sleep facing up tonight.
lines.zh: : 记得今晚要仰面朝上睡。

lines.en: scene black
I make my way out of the church and back into the street.
lines.zh: 我走出教堂，回到街上。

lines.en: I walk by a local restaurant and move through the steam leaking out of its exhaust pipe.
lines.zh: 我路过一家本地餐馆，穿过了从它排气管里漏出的蒸汽。

lines.en: I feel nothing.
lines.zh: 我什么都没感觉到。
